title: SR Search Toolkit: Proximity Builder, PICO Strategy Builder, and Search Syntax Converter
description:
Use it online (always the latest version): https://sunfloraf-sketch.github.io/sr-search-toolkit/

A set of three browser-based tools for systematic-review literature searching: a Proximity Builder that assembles adjacency/near fragments from synonym stacks, a PICO Strategy Builder that generates line-numbered strategies with controlled-vocabulary (MeSH / Emtree / CINAHL Headings) mapping, and a Search Syntax Converter that translates a query across seven databases/platforms (MEDLINE (Ovid), PubMed, Cochrane, Embase, CINAHL, Web of Science, Scopus). All tools run entirely in the browser; no data is uploaded.
